sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:95

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:95:1
items.html: They are divided into the discernment of thirteen corrections, for the ten Sefirot themselves are divided into thirteen for the aforementioned reason: That is, as above in the adjacent item: that out of the division of Bina into GAR [first three] and HGT, three new Sefirot are added, and this addition necessarily occurs also at the time of Katnut [smallness/infancy]. And therefore the ten Sefirot of Galgalta are divided into thirteen: for it has ten Sefirot from the three vessels, which are HBD HGT NHY, and the Atara of Yesod completes it to ten. And it has also three other corrections, which are Daat and the two holy apples. Meaning, when Bina is divided into GAR and ZAT, and the LM [Lamed-Mem] of Tzelem [image] is revealed in it, then the Daat of Radla [the unknown head] is revealed in it, in that air that is between Keter and Mocha Stimaa [the concealed brain]; and the two apples turn away from the hairs, and Hochma is revealed in them, in the secret of “the wisdom of a man illuminates his face.”
